Load input distributions

load_input_distributions.Rd

Loads the distributions of the input variables that are drawn in the stochastic dose calculation.

Usage

load_input_distributions(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path of an input distribution file (must be a YAML file). If null, the default input distributions are loaded.

Value

Named list of input distributions.

Details

Each input is drawn around its value: the value given in the input data, or else its default value. Its distribution only gives the shape:

  • trunc_lognormal: sd_rel (standard deviation relative to the value), min, max (lognormal truncated to min-max)

  • lognormal: sd_rel

  • beta: alpha (a0 = alpha/value)

  • dirichlet: a0 and group. The inputs of a group are shares of a whole and are drawn together with its rest (e.g. the speaker mode of calls).

  • categorical: probs, the probability of each value, for each given value

Inputs without a distribution are not drawn. The default input distributions (input_distributions.yaml) are generated from the same Excel file as the default values.

See also

simulate_inputs()
